bio: The world's largest association for security professionals, ASIS International has 243 chapters around the globe. Wherever you are in your career, whether just getting started or a seasoned security professional, ASIS International has the tools, information, and global network you need to achieve your goals. Put the power of ASIS to work for you.  www.asisonline.org

recentPosts.text: Our #MyASIS community is unmatched. We are in awe of our members’ dedication to the profession and each other, who are always looking for ways to support their colleagues and friends. In honor of Membership Appreciation Month we ask that you share your appreciation for your fellow members, maybe someone who has influenced your career or helped you in your ASIS journey? Tag a member in the comments below and be entered to win a FREE GSX All-Access Pass to #GSX2026. #ASISMemberAppreciation

Deepfakes, synthetic identities, and targeted phishing are putting pressure on financial institutions. On 4 November, Security Solutions Spotlight: Banking & Finance brings you practical strategies to strengthen your banking and finance security posture, with insights from the sector’s foremost experts.
Expect four live sessions, each followed by Q&A. Free for members and nonmembers.
Register now: https://bit.ly/4jowxiG

IT sets policies that affect your team with minimal input. Compliance findings surface issues you couldn’t see. Change windows follow IT’s timelines, not yours.
The gap between physical security and IT is a governance and communication problem, made worse by limited visibility into the device estate. Join this session to learn how physical security leaders can close that gap by leading the conversations on device ownership, visibility, and governance.
Free to all | Registration required
Thursday, 22 October 2026 | 12:30 pm ET | 1 CPE
Register now: https://bit.ly/4BmlOvN
Speaker: Roy Dagan
Sponsored by SecuriThings
